_comment: Advisories the npm audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) excuses. Each entry needs id, package, reason and recheck_by. It stops excusing once recheck_by passes, once the package publishes a version outside the vulnerable range, or once npm audit no longer reports it.

advisories.reason: No patched release (4.0.7 is the latest, inside <=4.0.7). Dev-only: reached through vite, vitest and tinyglobby, not shipped in dist/ (npm ls picomatch --omit=dev is empty). Triggering it needs a crafted glob pattern, and the only patterns are the repo's own build and test config.
